items.title: EU Speech-to-Text API Procurement: Compare Startup Pricing, SLOs, and Exit Tests
items.summary: 欧盟初创公司采购语音转文字API时，OpenAI、Deepgram、AssemblyAI和Google Cloud等供应商需通过EU数据边界、转录质量、端到端延迟（p50/p95/p99）和重放成本等门控测试，而非直接参考公开报价。月度运行成本计算公式为：计费处理 + 存储 + 传输 + 实测重放，需冻结实际工作负载并 replay 测试语料库获取 dated quotes。采购应"fail closed"，任何未通过接受标准的低价选项均应排除。
items.summary_en: The cheapest speech-to-text API for an EU startup isn't determined by per-minute pricing alone; vendors like OpenAI, Deepgram, AssemblyAI, and Google Cloud must first pass gates for EU data boundary compliance, transcript quality, end-to-end latency, and reliability before cost is compared. items.title: Humans missed 1 in 3 threats approving AI agent commands across 40k game runs
items.summary_en: A browser game testing human-in-the-loop oversight of AI coding agents revealed that humans missed 1 in 3 threats across over 40,000 runs and 409,000 approve/deny decisions, with 32.9% of sessions ending in a negative score. The most dangerous blind spot was `npm run` commands, which were approved 64.7% of the time even when the malicious payload was visible in the history log—hiding threats behind familiar script names roughly doubled the miss rate. The findings underscore that asking users to validate individual commands is a fragile security model, as agents can bypass approvals by modifying files to inject malicious code into trusted-looking commands.

items.title: [AINews] Jeff, Sanjay, Oriol, and Quoc depart DeepMind; Demis to Chair; Koray to SVP — what is going on at GDM???
items.summary: Jeff Dean、Sanjay Ghemawat、Oriol Vinyals和Quoc Le四位Google DeepMind核心研究者联合离职，共同创立面向自动科学发现的初创公司Discovery Loop，由Radical Ventures和Khosla Ventures领投种子轮融资。与此同时，Demis Hassabis从CEO转任DeepMind主席兼Alphabet首席科学家，Koray Kavukcuoglu接任DeepMind SVP并接管Gemini等日常运营。这一管理层大地震引发了外界对Google AI战略方向、Gemini Pro近半年无重大更新以及底层研发文化是否受阻的广泛猜测。
items.summary_en: Key figures including Jeff Dean, Sanjay Ghemawat, Oriol Vinyals, and Quoc Le are departing Google DeepMind to cofound Discovery Loop, a seed-funded automated ML and science discovery startup backed by Radical Ventures, Khosla Ventures, and Alphabet. Simultaneously, Demis Hassabis steps down as CEO to become Chair of DeepMind and Chief Scientist of Alphabet, while Koray Kavukcuoglu takes over as SVP running day-to-day operations. The article also notes Meta Spark 1.2 and Muse Code launching a 5.6T-parameter model with resumable background agents, and Prime Agent's self-improving RLM harness claiming 95.5% on ARC-AGI-3.

items.title: ChatGPT brings unlimited text chats to free users
items.summary: OpenAI宣布取消ChatGPT文本聊天限制，面向所有免费和Go用户开放，同时推出GPT-5.6 Luna作为默认模型并新增"Think"按钮以提升复杂问题的推理能力。Plus和Pro用户可获得升级版GPT-5.6 Sol模型，内部评估显示该模型较GPT-
items.summary_en: OpenAI is removing text-chat limits for all ChatGPT users, with the new GPT-5.6 Luna model replacing GPT-5.5 as the default for Free and Go users. Plus and Pro subscribers gain access to an upgraded GPT-5.6 Sol model and a thinking slider, with factual errors reduced by 62–68% compared to GPT-5.5-Instant. The app also recently surpassed 1 billion weekly users.

items.title: Qwen3.8 Max now ranked as the best overall model by agentic index
items.summary: Qwen3.8 Max在Artificial Analysis的Agentic Index中跃居综合排名第一。该指数基于Elo-500评分，通过agentic工具调用、编码、科学推理及长周期知识工作等任务评估模型表现。文章同时展示了AA-Briefcase、AA-Omniscience等多个独立基准的对比数据及成本性能分析。
items.summary_en: Qwen3.8 Max has been ranked the best overall AI model by Artificial Analysis's Agentic Index, which evaluates frontier models on real-world agentic tasks including tool use, coding, reasoning, and knowledge work. The evaluation platform also provides leaderboards across image, video, and speech generation, alongside metrics for cost per task, latency, openness, and hallucination rates through benchmarks like AA-Briefcase and AA-Omniscience.

items.title: Ex-Spotify employees raise $10M to bring the AI behind its recommendations to e-commerce
items.summary_en: Malachyte, a startup founded by three ex-Spotify engineers behind its Vector AI recommendation engine, has raised $10 million in seed funding to bring real-time, intent-aware personalization to e-commerce. The platform's "two-headed Vector AI" predicts shopper intent within a session using signals like clicks, hovers, and searches—no account or purchase history required—and has already served 20+ enterprise customers. It launched with Fun.com in fall 2025 and became generally available to Shopify merchants via a native integration in June 2026, with an API option for larger retailers.

items.title: AMD acquires Taalas to boost inference performance by etching models in silicon
items.summary: AMD收购AI芯片初创公司Taalas，通过在硅片上蚀刻模型专用集成电路（ASIC）来提升推理性能。早期技术演示显示，该方案可实现每秒高达17,000个token的处理速度，显著优于传统GPU推理方案。
items.summary_en: AMD has acquired AI chip startup Taalas to enhance inference performance by etching AI models directly into silicon. Early tech demos demonstrated model-specific integrated circuits capable of generating up to 17,000 tokens per second, marking a significant leap in inference speed over traditional approaches.

items.title: A Practical Guide to Running Codex CLI with a Custom Responses Provider
items.summary: 通过修改 Codex CLI 的 `~/.codex/config.toml` 配置文件，将 `base_url` 指向 Ace Data Cloud 的 `https://api.acedata.cloud/v1` 并设置 `wire_api = "responses"`，可将原生终端编程代理的请求路由至该兼容接口。配置前需通过 `export ACEDATACLOUD_API_KEY="{token}"` 设置环境变量，并执行 `codex logout` 清除原有 OpenAI 缓存。该方法支持 macOS、Linux、Windows 及 WSL，安装方式为 `npm install -g @openai/codex` 或 macOS 的 `brew install --cask codex`。
items.summary_en: This guide shows how to configure OpenAI's Codex CLI with Ace Data Cloud (api.acedata.cloud/v1) as a custom OpenAI Responses-compatible provider, using the wire_api = "responses" protocol and env_key = "ACEDATACLOUD_API_KEY" for authentication. The setup requires adding a provider block to ~/.codex/config.toml with the base URL, model (e.g., gpt-5), and reasoning effort, then clearing any cached OpenAI login via codex logout or by removing ~/.codex/auth.json. Codex CLI is installed globally via npm install -g @openai/codex or Homebrew on macOS.
